source_policy: synthetic text only; no real articles; no Jev outputs used for gold labels
gold_policy: single-annotator draft; blind second pass and adjudication required before quality claims
hash_policy: sha256 over exact UTF-8 bytes including the final LF

known_annotation_ambiguities.issue: taxonomy conflict: price event definition requires factual change; current request wording also permits an officially announced future change

A.purpose: Fixed broad benchmark; freeze before live evaluation.

B.purpose: Boundary and difficult-case analysis; do not fit production thresholds.

C.purpose: Metamorphic stimuli with prespecified expected relations; no Jev run has been made.

D.purpose: Separate control split; do not use for prompt, taxonomy, or threshold tuning. Gold labels are visible in this repository and were seen by the corpus author, so it is not a blind holdout.
